note: Support / escalation / contact knowledge. Always included in every Gemini fallback reply alongside the filtered FAQ subset.

faqs.q: Tutorial ya video guide kahan milega
faqs.answer: Hamara official YouTube channel @Mr.FSmsPortal hai: https://www.youtube.com/@Mr.FSmsPortal — yahan Login Not Available Solutions, number use karne ka tarika aur baaki common issues ke step-by-step video tutorials mojood hain.

faqs.q: Updates ke liye kahan follow karen
faqs.answer: Aap MRFSMS ka WhatsApp Channel join kar ke latest updates aur announcements paa sakte hain. Link Dashboard ke quick menu me maujood hai.

faqs.q: Kaunsa number stable hai kaise pata chale
faqs.answer: Dashboard par 'Live' button click karein — Live Feed me abhi ke stable/active numbers dikhte hain. OTP fail ho rahi ho to yahan se behtar number choose karna zyada faydemand hota hai.

faqs.q: Issue solve nahi ho raha ab kya karen
faqs.answer: Agar diye gaye steps se bhi issue solve nahi hota to Order ID, Service, Country aur (agar relevant ho) Screenshot bhej dein — support team case ko manually review kar ke jald az jald reply karegi.

faqs.q: Terms and agreement kahan parh sakte hain
faqs.answer: Terms & Conditions login/register ke waqt dikhaye jate hain aur accept karna zaroori hota hai. Inme OTP, ban, payment aur refund se related tamam policies clearly likhi hoti hain.
